subject: Close Readiness: MAP & Evaluation Acceptance Checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + acceptance tests for evaluation period

Alex — thanks again for the time today. As promised, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on defining clear success criteria, exit gates, and acceptance tests so your evaluation can finish on the timebox without surprises.

High level summary (2-week evaluation):
- Week 1: Integration + baseline tests (latency, token cost, basic functionality).
- Week 2: Feature scenarios, edge-case tests, and acceptance runbook.

Proposed exit gates (must be satisfied to move to PO decision):
1) Performance SLA: 95th-pct latency <= 250ms on synthetic baseline (median token length 120).
2) Cost target: per-1k-token inference cost <= $0.55 under continuous qps 10.
3) Quality: 3 representative prompts per product flow must pass acceptance criteria (see attached checklist).
4) Security/compliance: access logging confirmed + SOC 2 evidence stub provided.

Acceptance tests (examples):
- Functional: end-to-end generation for clinical summarization. Golden outputs compared by BLEU/ROUGE + manual QA pass (>= 90% accuracy on flagged items).
- Robustness: prompt-injection simulation (must not return PHI).
- Stability: 48-hour soak with scheduled bursts (no more than 1 transient 5xx per 100k tokens).

I've attached a compact MAP and an acceptance checklist spreadsheet. Can you confirm these gates look reasonable for your internal stakeholders? If yes, we can lock timelines and I’ll schedule a short sync with Marissa (solutions) and Ben (security) to cover the SOC evidence and deployment plan.

Next steps suggested:
- Alex: confirm or flag edits by EOD Tue 5/11.
- Jordan/Marissa/Ben: prepare SOC summary + deployment playbook.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + acceptance tests for evaluation period

Jordan — thanks for the fast follow. This is very helpful; appreciate the clarity. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency: 250ms at 95th for median 120 tokens sounds achievable. Can you confirm typical variation across regions? We're primarily in us-east.
2) Cost: is the $0.55 target based on Redwood-verified quantized model profile? We have a cost budget ceiling so would like a conservative projection.
3) Quality: instead of BLEU/ROUGE as primary signal, our clinical SME prefers token-level entity accuracy on 6 representative cases. Can we add that as an explicit pass/fail?

Also want to confirm timelines — our procurement team asked for the evaluation to finish by end of next week (5/21) to make a decision on the pilot budget. If we need extra time to run the soak, we should call that out in the MAP.

I will review the attached checklist and provide annotated edits by EOD today.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Johnson
Head of Product | AcmeHealth
alex@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0177
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + acceptance tests for evaluation period

Looping in some answers and actions for our side so we have a single source for Alex's questions: 

- Region behavior: we will run the hosted evaluation from us-east by default; I confirmed with infra that kernel selection and egress are identical for us-east/secondary region (latency variance typically <10%). We’ll run the baseline tests in us-east to match AcmeHealth.
- Cost basis: $0.55 is conservative and assumes q4_8bit quantized variant + auto-batching at qps=10. I’ll include a breakdown in the attachment with absolute and 95% CI numbers across expected token distributions.
- Quality metric swap: adding token-level entity accuracy is fine; we should include both automated metric (entity F1 >= 0.88) and manual SME pass (>=5/6 cases).

Operational asks from our side to make gates deterministic:
1) You provide the 6 representative clinical prompts + golden labels by Tue 5/12 17:00 ET.
2) We will run the baseline + acceptance suite on Wed 5/13 and deliver results by Thu 5/14.
3) If any gate fails, we allow one remediation attempt with a 48-hr re-run window; failure after remediation moves to escalation (procurement + legal).

I attached an updated MAP (v1.2) and an acceptance checklist that encodes the pass/fail thresholds, the test owner, and the runbook steps. I marked the fields where Alex's team needs to supply artifacts.

I'll also prepare the SOC evidence summary and loop Ben for any additional security questions.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0129
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: MAP accepted for timeline + SOC stub and checklist attached

Alex / Priya — quick note to confirm we’re good to proceed on the timeline you requested. Minor updates from security: 

- SOC & evidence: I attached a one-page SOC 2 evidence checklist (what we can provide during evaluation) and a stub log-export demonstrating request-level audit fields (timestamp, model-version, request-id).
- Data handling: during the evaluation we will default to ephemeral KV caching and no persistent storage; we will capture logs for debugging and then rotate them per your retention request.

Schedule (agreed):
- Tue 5/12 by 17:00 ET: AcmeHealth provides 6 prompts + golden labels (Priya).
- Wed 5/13: Redwood runs baseline + acceptance suite (us-east).
- Thu 5/14 by 12:00 PT: Redwood delivers results + remediation plan (if any).
- Fri 5/15: Final decision checkpoint for pilot go/no-go.

Attachments: AcmeHealth_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP with explicit gates), eval-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (test owners + pass/fail).

If this schedule still fits your procurement cutoff, we’ll mark the deal as on-track in HubSpot and kick off the runbook.

Ben
